item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Oof, that text was pretty small.

Well, I was able to solve it by changing the page's scale so I guess that's fine. But still, it would be nice if it was more accessible.

The format is pretty nice though, and I enjoyed the story. I imagined something like this (only in bigger scale) happening if that knife was used more often. This piece captures some aspects of social psychology that humans aren't very proud of. Poor MCF thought, they just wanted to do good. But well, it's EoD, what did they expect.

Overall, enthusiastic +1.

item.title: yyyea rite sry
item.content:encoded:
Reach was specifically requested to remove the format theme because, and I'm paraphrasing, it was painful to look at.

This, I'm glad to report, is not the same theme! It has different fonts, a different set of greens (durr, slightly different or the screen makes them look different, I don't even anymore) and the the MCF had designs for the Forums because I'd loved to make conversations of in-character personnel with the Wikidot Forums and make them pass as Manna personnel talking to each other online. Then again, that was just impractical at the time.

Also, glad to see the format stays alive. Planning two MCF ideas currently, not sure if I'd make them into SCP items or, rather, Programmes.

item.content:encoded: I deeply enjoyed every single thing about this. dado was completely in character, as was Manna Charitable. The deployment of a limited supply of temporary relief for the afflicted went about as expected given human nature. End of Death is truly the grimmest canon. Enthusiastic +1.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
apologies to anyone who tries fiddling with this in edit/page source, as I had to port over the manna charitable theme from the japanese/polish branches because it was deleted over here for some reason. did you know the MCF theme has designs for the Forums? now you do. (seriously what the hell was Reach thinking)

Anyway, wow! Manna Charitable! There hasn't been a GoI format for them in like 3 years or something, and I wanted to congratulate my good friend Captain Kirby for wrapping up Season 2 of his dope canon.

Special thanks to Captain Kirby, Elogee FishTruck, and RockTeethMothEyes for crit. I hope this inspires more people to write for MCF, as they're a pretty neat GoI I don't want to be forgotten.
